en.question: Where is it available?
en.answer: The Founders Limited Edition ships within Mexico only, and is sold exclusively through our website. We intend to ship the Limited Edition to the USA and Canada, expanding rapidly to more countries.

es.question: ¿Dónde está disponible?
es.answer: La Founders Limited Edition solo se envía dentro de México y se vende exclusivamente a través de nuestro sitio. Planeamos enviar la Limited Edition a Estados Unidos y Canadá, expandiéndonos rápidamente a más países.
